governing_statement: Constitutional Capitalism should not attempt to predict the future. It should be designed so that no plausible future makes its fundamental promise to the citizen collapse.
central_question: Does Constitutional Capitalism continue to protect individual agency, broad prosperity, democratic power and community resilience under radically different economic conditions?

operating_chain.sentence: Evidence → Comparative Diagnosis → Arkansas Needs → Human Capability → Local Pilot → Retain/Attract → Public Income & Ownership → Resilience Stress Test → Legal Feasibility → Measurement → Expansion
operating_chain.amends_prior: Evidence → comparative diagnosis → Arkansas design → legal feasibility → pilot → measurement → expansion (CC-DEC-115)

coherent_loop.statement: Arkansas inheritance → HYP-130 identifies what Arkansas lacks → HYP-133 develops human capability → HYP-129 proves systems locally → HYP-132 keeps/returns/attracts people and capital → productive ownership keeps more value local → HYP-131 converts portions of prosperity into public income → Prosperity Fund accumulates productive assets → HYP-134 tests whether automation can enlarge distributed prosperity → resilience testing determines whether the system survives radically different futures → the enlarged inheritance passes to the next generation.

five_state_resilience_test.role: Later validation dimension — does not alter current fiscal projections; HYP-134 remains quarantined from HYP-131 countable revenue

states.label: Normal
states.test: Does it function under present economic conditions?

states.label: Recession
states.test: Does it survive falling revenue, unemployment and asset losses?

states.label: Technological displacement
states.test: What happens when productivity rises while labor demand declines?

states.label: Severe disruption
states.test: Can communities maintain food, energy, healthcare, exchange, communications and government continuity?

states.label: Abundance
states.test: If AI/automation creates major surplus, who owns it and how is purchasing power distributed?

household_prosperity_test.equation: Income + ownership distributions + public benefits + public-service value − taxes − fees − essential household costs = Household Prosperity Surplus
household_prosperity_test.purpose: Prevent theoretically elegant reforms that make actual Arkansas families poorer

geographic_money_statements.geography: every county; communities where data permits
geographic_money_statements.central_question: How much value does this community produce, and how much does it retain?

revenue_stream_disposition.rule: Assign only after legal, fiscal, and incidence analysis — not as slogan
revenue_stream_disposition.purpose: Comprehensible destination for readers instead of disconnected revenue observations

categories.natural_capital: land, water, forests, minerals, agricultural capacity
categories.physical_capital: roads, schools, universities, hospitals, utilities, broadband
categories.human_capital: health, education, skills and productive capability
categories.intellectual_capital: research, public data, technology, institutional knowledge and publicly supported IP
categories.institutional_capital: functioning governments, universities, cooperatives, unions, civic organizations and legal systems
categories.productive_capital: businesses, farms, energy systems, machinery and eventually AI/robotic productive capacity
categories.financial_capital: household wealth, community capital and Prosperity Fund assets

intergenerational_capital_ledgers.generational_test: Did this generation leave Arkansas with more real capital per citizen than it inherited?

ai_social_compact.principle_candidate_not_locked: AI may augment the power of people, enterprises and government, but it may never replace the sovereignty of the citizen

economic_continuity.question: How does an Arkansas community continue exchanging necessities when ordinary payment, communications or banking infrastructure temporarily fails?

hyp134_ownership_test_when_gate_opens.rule: Build pre-transition dataset first; then model the same productivity shock under different ownership systems — not fantasy productivity as revenue
hyp134_ownership_test_when_gate_opens.claim_under_test: Broad ownership can turn automation into abundance rather than dependency
hyp134_ownership_test_when_gate_opens.quarantine: Does not alter HYP-131 COUNTABLE or demoted stack ceilings

immediate_build_sequence_unchanged.hyp133: Demand Map remains first empirical pass
immediate_build_sequence_unchanged.resilience: RES-OBJ-FOOD-HUB-DOLLAR-PATH rides along; no separate build

completion_first_discipline.objective: BUILD THE COMPLETE SYSTEM → FINISH THE BOOK → identify gaps → stress-test → refine → implementation-grade validation
completion_first_discipline.build_strategy: Breadth first. Completeness second. Depth third. Proof fourth.
completion_first_discipline.governing_question: Did this materially move Constitutional Capitalism toward a finished system?
completion_first_discipline.rejects: perfect one module → perfect another → discover three more questions → never finish
completion_first_discipline.deep_research_gate_rule: No new area gets a deep research bind unless failure to resolve it prevents us from explaining how the system works.

module_maturity_standard.purpose: What finished ultimately means — higher than writing policy chapters
module_maturity_standard.implication_for_43_percent: Substantial research and architecture exist; the harder second half is proving mechanisms work financially, constitutionally, geographically, behaviorally and under stress — advanced by finishing the system/book via ten structural locks, not endless module perfection
